sentences.text: Fabian Cancellara -LRB- born 18 March 1981 -RRB- , nicknamed `` Spartacus '' , is a Swiss former professional road bicycle racer who last rode for UCI ProTeam .	Swiss	Swiss people	road bicycle racer	road bicycle racer	UCI ProTeam	UCI ProTeam
He was born in Wohlen bei Bern , Switzerland .	Wohlen bei Bern	Wohlen bei Bern
Cancellara began road cycling after falling in love with an old bike at the age of thirteen .	road cycling	road cycling

After that , he began to take the sport more seriously and won two consecutive World Junior Time Trial Championships in 1998 and 1999 .	1998	1998 UCI Road World Championships	1999	1999 UCI Road World Championships
At age nineteen he turned professional and signed with the team , where he rode as a stagiaire .	stagiaire	Glossary of cycling#stagiaire

He is known for being a quality time trialist , a one-day classics specialist , and a workhorse for his teammates that have general classification aspirations .	time trialist	time trialist	classics	Classic cycle races	workhorse	Domestique

After winning a few stages and small races in his starting years , Cancellara earned his first major victory at the 2004 Tour de France where he won the opening prologue time trial and wore race leader yellow jersey for one day .	Tour de France	Tour de France	2004	2004 Tour de France	2004 Tour de France	2004 Tour de France

The following season saw fewer victories , but his 2006 season saw a victory in the men 's time trial at the UCI Road World Championships , along with victory at the Paris -- Roubaix .	2006	2006 Paris–Roubaix	World Championships	UCI Road World Championships	UCI Road World Championships	UCI Road World Championships
Cancellara repeated as world champion in the time trial the next year , along with winning two stages at the Tour de France .	Tour de France	Tour de France

During the 2008 calendar he won gold at the Summer Olympics in the individual time trial event and the Milan -- San Remo .	2008	2008 Milan–San Remo	Summer Olympics	2008 Summer Olympics	individual time trial	Cycling at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's road time trial
The next season saw Cancellara again become world time trial champion and lead both the Tour de France and the Vuelta a España .	Tour de France	Tour de France	Vuelta a España	2009 Vuelta a España
In 2010 , he won the Paris -- Roubaix and the Tour of Flanders .	2010	2010 Tour of Flanders	Tour of Flanders	Tour of Flanders

Cancellara 's 2011 and 2012 campaigns were both short in number of victories , while the latter was hampered by injuries throughout .	2012	2012 Strade Bianche	2011	2011 national road cycling championships
After a lackluster two-year period , Cancellara again won the Tour of Flanders and Paris -- Roubaix double in 2013 .	2013	2013 E3 Harelbeke	Tour of Flanders	Tour of Flanders
In 2014 , Cancellara repeated as winner of the Tour of Flanders .	2014	2014 Tour of Flanders	Tour of Flanders	Tour of Flanders
Since turning professional in 2000 , Cancellara has ridden for four professional teams .

He has achieved great success in the classic monuments ; he has won Paris -- Roubaix three times , the Milan -- San Remo once , and the Tour of Flanders three times .	Tour of Flanders	Tour of Flanders	monuments	Cycling monument
Cancellara has won the opening stage of the Tour de France five times and has led the race for 29 days total , which is the most of any rider who has not won the Tour .	Tour de France	Tour de France

His success has not been limited to just time trials and classics , as he has won general classification of the Tirreno -- Adriatico , Tour de Suisse , and the Tour of Oman .	Tour de Suisse	Tour de Suisse	Tour of Oman	Tour of Oman	classics	Classic cycle races

In 2008 , he won gold in the individual time trial and silver in the men 's road race at the Summer Olympics .	2008	2008 Milan–San Remo	Summer Olympics	2008 Summer Olympics	individual time trial	Cycling at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's road time trial

In 2016 , he won Olympic gold in the individual time trial for the second time in his career .	2016	2016 Strade Bianche	individual time trial	Cycling at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's road time trial	Olympic	Cycling at the 2016 Summer Olympics
